goal: Make Project Decomposition Tree the mandatory production index across planning, issue mapping, exact ProviderJob repair, partial acceptance, and evidence updates.
acceptance_criteria: The production mainline writes a schema-valid tree before Provider generation and retains it with the provisional candidate.
CASE01 and CASE03 capabilities use stable production-derived node IDs without benchmark-specific routing.
Every repair action has an exact node, issue, expected/observed behavior, evidence, target source, and affected-behavior probe.
Missing-main and Selenium verifier failures are repairable semantic issues while unsafe/fake/malformed facts remain fatal.
Focused regression proves no generic scope expansion, no second Provider scheduler, and unchanged final gate.

quality_metrics.measure: tree-node coverage for repairable issue-led repair actions
quality_metrics.method: new tree integration regressions plus focused production/kernel suite

prevention: Use one deterministic support index and reuse the existing production split-file ProviderJob executor.
assurance: Validate tree schema, stable node mapping, frozen benchmark hashes, and final-gate invariants.
control: Run environment, slim guard, kernel contract, focused pytest, py_compile, and provider-gated trimmed live checks.
improvement: Use EXP-CGKN-QUALITY-001 by keeping planning, candidate implementation, and release truth separate in the tree authority contract.

interface_expectations: The tree has no scheduling, candidate-write, evidence, package, or delivery authority.
ProviderJob remains the only project-work unit and the production split-file executor remains the only scheduler.
The final evaluator, local_packager, public delivery gate, and benchmark files remain unchanged.

feedback: Focused regression passed 92 tests with 8 explicit skips; environment, slim guard, kernel contract, and py_compile passed.

Fresh CASE03 materialized, reached the unified issue ledger, mapped static-root failure to capability.static_web_entry and backend.leaf.001/app/main.py, and accepted one DOM delta with an Evidence Tree update without case-score improvement.
Fresh CASE01 created its required tree but qwen-plus repeatedly returned incomplete output for a required tests leaf, so no candidate or static-root post-build evidence was fabricated.

worked: One node namespace now connects generation planning, issue routing, exact ProviderJob repair, and acceptance evidence.
Unmapped issues were made non-repairable while every live Provider repair action carried a tree_node_id.
EXP-CGKN-QUALITY-001 kept support-tree status separate from candidate, evaluator, package, and final-gate truth.
did_not_work: CASE01 could not reach candidate materialization because the live Provider exhausted its existing output-contract retry budget.
CASE03 remained PROJECT_FAIL after bounded repair because static startup and foundation issues remained.
experiments: Next isolate Provider incomplete-output durability for required test/document leaves without adding retries, schedulers, or timeout.
